results.content: # Press Release: Jennifer Ward Oppenheimer Research Grant Opens 2026 Call for Applications::. **Johannesburg, South Africa (23 March)**– The Jennifer Ward Oppenheimer (JWO) Research Grant will open its 2026 call for applications on 23 March 2026, inviting early-career African scientists to submit research proposals that advance biodiversity and conservation on the continent. Applicants must demonstrate strong links to a credible African institution capable of managing grant funding, and proposed research must be focused on or conducted in Africa. The JWO Research Grant responds directly to this imbalance by investing in African scholars whose work addresses complex environmental challenges from within the region. “The JWO Research Grant reflects our long-term commitment to strengthen African scientific leadership. “Last year, the JWO Research Grant received a record 848 applications from 30 African countries, underscoring the depth and diversity of scientific talent across the continent. The grant has contributed to strengthening institutional networks across Africa, while reinforcing the visibility of African-led research within global environmental discourse.

results.content: # Applications are now open for the JWO Research Grant 2026 for early-career scientists conducting impactful research (grant of $150,000 awarded). ## Applications are now open for the JWO Research Grant 2026 for early-career scientists conducting impactful research (grant of $150,000 awarded). The Jennifer Ward Oppenheimer Research Grant (JWO Research Grant) was established to honour the late Mrs Jennifer Ward Oppenheimer and continue her extensive contribution to and passion for Africa, the environment, and science. The Jennifer Ward Oppenheimer (JWO) Research Grant seeks to support innovative, African-led research that will contribute to the advancement of environmental and allied sciences; and address relevant, real-world issues of current and future importance. ### About The Jennifer Ward Oppenheimer Research Grant. * All pre-proposal and full-proposal applications will be reviewed by the The Jennifer Ward Oppenheimer Research Grant Expert Panel, a distinguished panel comprised of internal and external members with significant experience across academia, Africa, research and environmental science.
